title: Markdown data layer (filesystem mode)
description: Lenient frontmatter loader for content/projects + content/fields; unified pipeline (remark-gfm, @flowershow/remark-wiki-link, @r4ai/remark-callout, rehype-sanitize + highlight); /attachments dev route; replace Projects.getAll/Fields.getAll. Site fully works locally offline. Phase 3.

title: Toolchain: Svelte 5, Kit 2.69+, Vite 7, sv migrate
description: Update all deps, run npx sv migrate svelte-5, get check/lint/build green. Notion data layer allowed to be broken (deleted in phase 4). Decide tailwind 3 vs 4 here. Phase 2 in docs/migrate-to-markdown.md.

title: Foundation: branch v4, land content/, docs/, beads
description: Create v4 off main. Stash update-everything dirty junk. Commit content/ (27 notes + 55 attachments), docs/migrate-to-markdown.md, beads export. See docs/migrate-to-markdown.md phase 1.

title: Launch: tests, deploy, verify prod
description: Playwright smoke tests, deploy, verify prod rendering + revalidation on real domain, update README. Phase 9.

title: Publish loop: revalidate webhook + ignored build step
description: /api/revalidate: verify GitHub HMAC, map changed files to routes, fire x-prerender-revalidate per path + /. Vercel Ignored Build Step: git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- . ':(exclude)content/'. Configure GitHub webhook. E2E: content-only push goes live with no build. Phase 7.

title: Visual parity + Svelte 5 idioms
description: Port components to runes where sv migrate left legacy patterns. Verify pool/particles/fireworks/field filters/project modal against live site. Phase 5.

title: Remote content mode: GitHub fetch + ISR
description: Contents API fetch layer with HEAD-sha resolution; SHA-pinned raw URLs for media; dev/prod mode switch; ISR config with bypassToken; env GITHUB_TOKEN + CONTENT_REF. Phase 6.

title: Delete Notion/S3/Postgres code and creds
description: Remove Notion.ts, S3.ts, Projects.ts, Fields.ts, notion-asset route, jobs/ dead code, @notionhq/client, @vercel/postgres deps. Revoke old Notion API key, delete Vercel Postgres store, prune .env. Phase 4.

title: Vault ergonomics + content cleanup
description: .obsidian/ in content/ (gitignore workspace.json); fix localhost link in fields/music.md, sapper dupe in fields/dev.md; curate. Phase 8.
